1: import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
2: 
3: export const loadAsync = async <T, P>(
4:   request: (params: P) => Promise<T>,
5:   params: P,
6:   setData: (data: T | null) => void,
7:   setError: (error: Error | null) => void,
8:   setLoading: (loading: boolean) => void
9: ): Promise<void> => {
10:   setLoading(true)
11: 
12:   try {
13:     const response = await request(params)
14:     setData(response)
15:     setError(null)
16:   } catch (e: unknown) {
17:     setError(e instanceof Error ? e : new Error('unknown error'))
18:     setData(null)
19:   } finally {
20:     setLoading(false)
21:   }
22: }
23: 
24: export type Return<T> = {
25:   data: T | null
26:   error: Error | null
27:   loading: boolean
28:   refresh: () => void
29: }
30: 
31: export const useLoadAsync = <T, P>(request: (params: P) => Promise<T>, params: P): Return<T> => {
32:   const [data, setData] = useState<T | null>(null)
33:   const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null)
34:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true)
35: 
36:   const load = useCallback(() => {
37:     loadAsync<T, P>(request, params, setData, setError, setLoading).catch(e => setError(e))
38:     /* For small objects JSON.stringify is good enough. But does not work with ESLint rule */
39:     // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
40:   }, [request, JSON.stringify(params)])
41: 
42:   useEffect(() => {
43:     load()
44:   }, [load])
45: 
46:   return { data, error, loading, refresh: load }
47: }
48: 
49: export default useLoadAsync

1: import { RouteProp, useFocusEffect } from '@react-navigation/native'
2: import { StackNavigationProp } from '@react-navigation/stack'
3: import normalize from 'normalize-strings'
4: import React, { useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
5: import { Pressable, ScrollView } from 'react-native'
6: import styled, { useTheme } from 'styled-components/native'
7: 
8: import Button from '../../components/Button'
9: import DisciplineListItem from '../../components/DisciplineListItem'
10: import Header from '../../components/Header'
11: import HorizontalLine from '../../components/HorizontalLine'
12: import RouteWrapper from '../../components/RouteWrapper'
13: import SearchBar from '../../components/SearchBar'
14: import ServerResponseHandler from '../../components/ServerResponseHandler'
15: import { ContentSecondary, ContentTextBold, ContentTextLight } from '../../components/text/Content'
16: import { Heading } from '../../components/text/Heading'
17: import { BUTTONS_THEME } from '../../constants/data'
18: import { Discipline } from '../../constants/endpoints'
19: import { formatDiscipline } from '../../hooks/helpers'
20: import { useLoadAllDisciplines } from '../../hooks/useLoadAllDisciplines'
21: import { useLoadDisciplines } from '../../hooks/useLoadDisciplines'
22: import useReadSelectedProfessions from '../../hooks/useReadSelectedProfessions'
23: import { RoutesParams } from '../../navigation/NavigationTypes'
24: import { pushSelectedProfession, setSelectedProfessions } from '../../services/AsyncStorage'
25: import { getLabels, splitTextBySearchString } from '../../services/helpers'
26: 
27: const HighlightContainer = styled.Text<{ disabled: boolean }>`
28:   flex-direction: row;
29:   color: ${props => (props.disabled ? props.theme.colors.disabled : props.theme.colors.black)};
30: `
31: 
32: const TextContainer = styled.View`
33:   margin-top: ${props => props.theme.spacings.xxl};
34:   margin-bottom: ${props => props.theme.spacings.lg};
35: `
36: 
37: const StyledText = styled(ContentSecondary)`
38:   text-align: center;
39: `
40: 
41: const SearchContainer = styled.View`
42:   margin: ${props => props.theme.spacings.sm};
43: `
44: 
45: const ScopeContainer = styled.View`
46:   margin: 0 ${props => props.theme.spacings.sm};
47: `
48: 
49: const ButtonContainer = styled.View`
50:   margin: ${props => props.theme.spacings.md} auto;
51: `
52: 
53: export const searchProfessions = (disciplines: Discipline[] | undefined, searchKey: string): Discipline[] | undefined =>
54:   disciplines?.filter(discipline =>
55:     normalize(discipline.title).toLowerCase().includes(normalize(searchKey.toLowerCase()))
56:   )
57: 
58: const highlightText = (textArray: [string] | [string, string, string], disabled: boolean): JSX.Element => (
59:   <HighlightContainer disabled={disabled}>
60:     <ContentTextLight>{textArray[0]}</ContentTextLight>
61:     <ContentTextBold>{textArray[1]}</ContentTextBold>
62:     <ContentTextLight>{textArray[2]}</ContentTextLight>
63:   </HighlightContainer>
64: )
65: 
66: type IntroScreenProps = {
67:   route: RouteProp<RoutesParams, 'ScopeSelection'>
68:   navigation: StackNavigationProp<RoutesParams, 'ScopeSelection'>
69: }
70: 
71: type SearchResultsProps = {
72:   filteredProfessions: Discipline[] | undefined
73:   selectedProfessions: number[] | null
74:   searchString: string
75:   onProfessionSelected: (profession: Discipline) => Promise<void>
76: }
77: 
78: const SearchResults = ({
79:   filteredProfessions,
80:   selectedProfessions,
81:   searchString,
82:   onProfessionSelected,
83: }: SearchResultsProps): JSX.Element => (
84:   <ScopeContainer>
85:     {filteredProfessions?.map(profession => {
86:       const disabled = !!selectedProfessions?.includes(profession.id)
87:       return (
88:         <Pressable key={profession.id} onPress={() => onProfessionSelected(profession)} disabled={disabled}>
89:           {highlightText(splitTextBySearchString(profession.title, searchString), disabled)}
90:           <HorizontalLine />
91:         </Pressable>
92:       )
93:     })}
94:   </ScopeContainer>
95: )
96: 
97: const ScopeSelectionScreen = ({ navigation, route }: IntroScreenProps): JSX.Element => {
98:   const { initialSelection } = route.params
99:   const { data: disciplines, error, loading, refresh } = useLoadDisciplines({ parent: null })
100:   const { data: selectedProfessions, refresh: refreshSelectedProfessions } = useReadSelectedProfessions()
101:   const allProfessions = useLoadAllDisciplines()
102:     .data?.filter(discipline => discipline.total_discipline_children === 0)
103:     .map(discipline => formatDiscipline(discipline, {}))
104:   const [searchString, setSearchString] = useState<string>('')
105:   const [showSearchResults, setShowSearchResults] = useState<boolean>(false)
106:   const filteredProfessions = useMemo(
107:     () => searchProfessions(allProfessions, searchString),
108:     [allProfessions, searchString]
109:   )
110:   const theme = useTheme()
111: 
112:   useFocusEffect(refreshSelectedProfessions)
113: 
114:   useLayoutEffect(() => {
115:     navigation.setOptions({ headerShown: !initialSelection })
116:   })
117: 
118:   const navigateToDiscipline = (item: Discipline): void => {
119:     navigation.navigate('ProfessionSelection', {
120:       discipline: item,
121:       initialSelection,
122:     })
123:   }
124: 
125:   const navigateToHomeScreen = async () => {
126:     if (selectedProfessions === null) {
127:       await setSelectedProfessions([])
128:     }
129:     navigation.reset({
130:       index: 0,
131:       routes: [{ name: 'BottomTabNavigator' }],
132:     })
133:   }
134: 
135:   const disciplineItems = disciplines?.map(item => (
136:     <DisciplineListItem key={item.id} item={item} onPress={() => navigateToDiscipline(item)} hasBadge={false} />
137:   ))
138: 
139:   return (
140:     <RouteWrapper
141:       backgroundColor={initialSelection ? theme.colors.primary : theme.colors.background}
142:       lightStatusBarContent={initialSelection}>
143:       <ScrollView>
144:         {initialSelection && <Header />}
145: 
146:         <TextContainer>
147:           {initialSelection ? (
148:             <StyledText>{getLabels().scopeSelection.welcome}</StyledText>
149:           ) : (
150:             <Heading centered>{getLabels().manageSelection.addProfession}</Heading>
151:           )}
152:           <StyledText>{getLabels().scopeSelection.selectProfession}</StyledText>
153:         </TextContainer>
154:         <SearchContainer>
155:           <SearchBar
156:             query={searchString}
157:             setQuery={input => {
158:               setSearchString(input)
159:               setShowSearchResults(input.length > 0)
160:             }}
161:             placeholder={getLabels().scopeSelection.searchProfession}
162:           />
163:         </SearchContainer>
164:         {showSearchResults ? (
165:           <SearchResults
166:             filteredProfessions={filteredProfessions}
167:             selectedProfessions={selectedProfessions}
168:             searchString={searchString}
169:             onProfessionSelected={async profession => {
170:               await pushSelectedProfession(profession.id).then(() => {
171:                 navigation.navigate('ManageSelection')
172:               })
173:             }}
174:           />
175:         ) : (
176:           <ServerResponseHandler error={error} loading={loading} refresh={refresh}>
177:             <ScopeContainer>{disciplineItems}</ScopeContainer>
178:           </ServerResponseHandler>
179:         )}
180:         {initialSelection && (
181:           <ButtonContainer>
182:             <Button
183:               onPress={navigateToHomeScreen}
184:               label={
185:                 selectedProfessions && selectedProfessions.length > 0
186:                   ? getLabels().scopeSelection.confirmSelection
187:                   : getLabels().scopeSelection.skipSelection
188:               }
189:               buttonTheme={BUTTONS_THEME.contained}
190:             />
191:           </ButtonContainer>
192:         )}
193:       </ScrollView>
194:     </RouteWrapper>
195:   )
196: }
197: 
198: export default ScopeSelectionScreen
